items.title: 从手工取样到智能智造 仿真花“开”出亿级大市场

items.titleEn: From hand-held sampling to smart smartphones, imitating flowers has opened up a multi-billion dollar market.
items.summaryEn: The flowers are influenced by the seasons, but there is a flower that does not need water or fade, and it is a simulation flower. items.title: 小仙炖以品类创新拉动产业链升级｜一碗鲜炖燕窝背后，中国消费创新的亚太溢出效应
items.summary: APEC中国年，备受关注的三大优先领域依然是“开放、创新、合作”。落到产业层面，就是以开放打破壁垒，以创新培育动能，以合作放大优势。如果说，过去中国消费品牌的出海史，更多是一部“产品远航”与“原料采购”的历史，那么今天，一种更深层的范式正在浮现——以品类创新重构产业链，以产业共生赢得未来。
items.titleEn: Sendai has created a brand-new pull chain, and behind a bowl of bright lights, China's consumption of innovation is spilling over into the Asia-Pacific.
items.summaryEn: In APEC China, the top three priority areas remained open-mindedness, innovation and cooperation. To reach the industrial level, it is to openly break down barriers, to innovate, to foster dynamism and to work together to increase our strengths. If the history of Chinese consumer brands in the past is more of a history of aluminum products traveling far and wide with the purchase of aluminum raw materials, then today, a deeper paradigm is emerging for aluminum to rebuild industrial chains through brand innovation in order to win the future of industrial coexistence.

items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
